coverage: Four complete versioned original PDFs unchanged (Qwen-VL, Qwen2-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL). Qwen3.5 supplement: full pinned official flagship model card and config/processor files, full official release article, official repository release-history entries, and relevant pinned Transformers model implementation (vision interface, hybrid attention, recurrent/chunk kernels, router/shared experts, cache, positional IDs). No independent standalone Qwen3.5 technical report verified; release article still says upcoming technical report. No training or benchmark reruns; exact training recipe, ablations and complete per-task decoding/tool protocols remain unknown. Repository redirect to Qwen3.8 does not expand this series scope. Catalog published date remains latest actual included paper first submission; Qwen3.5 model release date is recorded separately.

claims.locator: Model Overview Hidden Layout; config.json layer_types / vision_config
claims.statement: 示意图使用旗舰60层=15组(3 GatedDeltaNet+1 GatedAttention)，每层后MoE，final merger序列输入而非DeepStack支路。
GatedDeltaNet缓存递归state和卷积state，incremental sequence1使用recurrent kernel，prefill用chunk kernel；Full Attention更新KV并sigmoid(output gate)；每层后MoE。
解释性公式Stilde=alpha*Sprev；delta=beta*(v-Stilde^T k)；S=Stilde+k delta^T；o=S^T q；alpha=exp(g), beta=sigmoid(b)，省略norm/causal conv/output gating但明确q/k normalized q scaled。
mrope_interleaved=true，mrope_section=[11,11,10]，partial_rotary_factor=.25；Full Attention参考实现apply_rotary_pos_emb，不可自动写成所有DeltaNet层同样q/k RoPE。

claims.locator: Model Overview Mixture Of Experts; config.json num_experts / num_experts_per_tok / shared_expert_intermediate_size
claims.statement: 旗舰512 routed experts，10 routed+1shared per token，expert intermediate1024；总量397B active17B是型号报告，非全部可驻留于17B权重显存。
softmax→topk→selected-score renormalization；weighted routed sum + sigmoid-gated shared expert输出；hidden维度保持。
model card MTP trained multi-steps；config mtp_num_hidden_layers1；不保证全部服务配置自动speculative decode。
分析：state-cache减少逐tokenKV覆盖范围但full-attention仍保留KV，不消除vision/全部expert存储/通信开销；不独立估算latency。
原生early text-vision fusion，视觉/STEM/视频等数据扩大；沿Qwen3-Next hybrid architecture/MTP；heterogeneous vision-language parallelism；native FP8 with BF16 sensitive layers。
官方称扩大RL environments，涵盖text/multimodal/multiturn asynchronous disaggregated train-inference，router replay and multi-turn rollout locking；未给足完整训练loss/冻结课程，不默认继承前代SAPO。
